text:
debrief db-021
row 1:  the a-c-t-o-r d-r-a-f-t-e-d c-o-v-e-r b-i-d d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t-s for the two competing firms, p-r-i-c-e-d at roughly 3 percent above the l-e-a-d a-w-a-r-d b-i-d | u-s-e-d g-a-n-s-h-e-e-t b-i-d f-o-r-m s p-l-u-s e-m-b-e-d-d-e-d c-o-s-t s-c-h-e-d-u-l-e s w-i-t-h i-d-e-n-t-i-c-a-l l-i-n-e i-t-e-m s | k-e-p-t f-i-l-e n-a-m-e s in a s-e-p-a-r-a-t-e d f-o-l-d-e-r o-u-t-s-i-d-e the o-f-f-i-c-i-a l t-e-n-d-e-r r-e-p-o-s-i-t-o-r-y so p-r-o-c-u-r-e-m-e-n-t s-t-a-f-f n-e-v-e-r i-n-d-e-x-e-d them | r-u-n a n-y-s-t-a-g-e s-t-r-i-n-g c-o-m-p-a-r-i-s-o-n a-c-r-o-s-s a-l-l b-i-d l-i-n-e i-t-e-m s to c-a-t-c-h m-a-t-c-h-e-d l-a-b-o-r r-a-t-e s and i-d-e-n-t-i-c-a l s-u-b-c-o-n-t-r-a-c-t-o-r l-i-n-e s

row 2:  the a-c-t-o-r s-h-a-r-e-d b-o-t-t-o-m l-i-n-e p-r-i-c-i-n-g with the two competitors via a s-h-a-r-e-d c-l-o-u-d f-o-l-d-e-r | u-s-e-d a s-h-a-r-e-d g-o-o-g-l-e d-r-i-v-e f-o-l-d-e-r n-a-m-e-d "m-u-n-i c-i-p-a l t-e-n-d-e-r w-o-r-k-s-p-a-c-e" with l-i-n-k s-h-a-r-i-n-g and v-i-e-w-o-n-l-y p-e-r-m-i-s-s-i-o-n-s turned off for e-d-i-t access | o-m-i-t-t-e-d a n-y r-e-f-e-r-e-n-c-e to the f-o-l-d-e-r in o-f-f-i-c-i-a l t-e-n-d-e-r s-u-b-m-i-s-s-i-o-n-s and u-s-e-d a p-e-r-s-o-n-a l e-m-a-i l a-c-c-o-u-n-t for all c-o-m-m-u-n-i-c-a-t-i-o-n-s | a-u-d-i-t f-i-l-e m-e-t-a-d-a-t-a a-c-c-e-s-s l-o-g-s on the s-h-a-r-e-d f-o-l-d-e-r to i-d-e-n-t-i-f-y non-b-i-d-d-e-r a-c-c-e-s-s during the p-r-i-c-i-n-g p-e-r-i-o-d

row 3:  the a-c-t-o-r s-e-t u-p a r-o-t-a-t-i-o-n s-c-h-e-d-u-l-e designating which firm w-o-u-l-d w-i-n each p-h-a-s-e of the c-o-n-s-t-r-u-c-t-i-o-n t-e-n-d-e-r | u-s-e-d a s-p-r-e-a-d-s-h-e-e-t m-a-r-k-e-d "i-n-t-e-r-n-a l p-l-a-n n-i-n-g" h-i-d-d-e-n on a p-a-s-s-w-o-r-d p-r-o-t-e-c-t-e-d e-x-t-e-r-n-a l h-a-r-d d-r-i-v-e, with d-a-t-e s and f-i-r-m i-n-i-t-i-a-l-s in c-o-l-u-m-n a | c-l-a-s-s-i-f-i-e-d the s-c-h-e-d-u-l-e as a "c-h-a-r-t-e-r e-d p-r-i-v-a-t-e m-e-e-t-i-n-g n-o-t-e" in c-o-m-m-u-n-i-c-a-t-i-o-n-s so it w-o-u-l-d n-o-t t-r-i-g-g-e-r a c-o-n-f-l-i-c-t of i-n-t-e-r-e-s-t r-e-v-i-e-w | r-e-q-u-e-s-t f-r-o-m the c-a-r-r-i-e-r a f-u-l l r-o-t-a-t-i-o-n o-f p-r-i-c-i-n-g a-s-s-u-m-p-t-i-o-n-s and c-r-o-s-s-c-h-e-c-k a-g-a-i-n-s-t the a-c-t-u-a l a-w-a-r-d h-i-s-t-o-r-y

row 4:  the a-c-t-o-r a-r-r-a-n-g-e-d s-t-i-n-g s-u-b-c-o-n-t-r-a-c-t-s to f-u-n-d t-h-e s-h-a-r-e-d c-o-s-t-s | d-r-a-w-n i-n-v-o-i-c-e s from a s-h-e-l l c-o-r-p-o-r-a-t-i-o-n the a-c-t-o-r o-w-n-s, l-i-s-t-e-d as "c-o-n-s-u-l-t-i-n-g s-e-r-v-i-c-e s" p-a-i-d to the two competitors' p-r-i-n-c-i-p-a l-s p-e-r-s-o-n-a l a-c-c-o-u-n-t-s | u-s-e-d a s-h-e-l l c-o-r-p-o-r-a-t-i-o-n r-e-g-i-s-t-e-r-e-d o-u-t-s-t-a-t-e to a-v-o-i-d a-p-p-e-a-r-i-n-g in the m-u-n-i-c-i-p-a l-v-e-n-d-o-r r-e-g-i-s-t-e-r, and r-o-u-t-e-d p-a-y-m-e-n-t-s t-h-r-o-u-g-h a m-u-l-t-i-t-i-e-d h-o-l-d-i-n-g e-n-t-i-t-y | m-a-t-c-h v-e-n-d-o-r i-n-v-o-i-c-e s a-g-a-i-n-s-t the m-u-n-i-c-i-p-a l-v-e-n-d-o-r r-e-g-i-s-t-e-r and f-l-a-g any c-o-n-s-u-l-t-i-n-g f-e-e s p-a-i-d to non-c-o-n-t-r-a-c-t-o-r i-n-d-i-v-i-d-u-a-l-s

row 5:  the a-c-t-o-r l-i-s-t-e-d all three firms as i-n-d-e-p-e-n-d-e-n-t b-i-d-d-e-r-s on the o-f-f-i-c-i-a l t-e-n-d-e-r r-e-s-p-o-n-s-e | s-u-b-m-i-t-t-e-d s-e-p-a-r-a-t-e b-i-d p-a-c-k-a-g-e s from t-h-r-e-e d-i-f-f-e-r-e-n-t o-f-f-i-c-e a-d-d-r-e-s-s-e-s, e-a-c-h w-i-t-h its own b-i-d b-o-n-d, p-r-e-p-a-r-e-d on s-l-i-g-h-t-l-y d-i-f-f-e-r-e-n-t p-r-i-c-i-n-g s-p-r-e-a-d-s (1.5 to 4 percent a-b-o-v-e the w-i-n n-i-n-g b-i-d) | u-s-e-d t-h-r-e-e d-i-f-f-e-r-e-n-t o-f-f-i-c-e a-d-d-r-e-s-s-e-s and b-i-d b-o-n-d p-r-o-v-i-d-e-r-s so the s-t-a-n-d-a-r-d d-u-p-l-i-c-a-t-e b-i-d s-c-r-e-e-n-i-n-g w-o-u-l-d n-o-t c-a-t-c-h the c-o-m-m-o-n o-w-n-e-r-s-h-i-p | r-u-n a b-e-n-e-f-i-c-i-a l o-w-n-e-r-s-h-i-p d-i-s-c-l-o-s-u-r-e c-h-e-c-k on every b-i-d-d-e-r, c-r-o-s-s-r-e-f-e-r-e-n-c-i-n-g c-o-r-p-o-r-a-t-e r-e-g-i-s-t-r-y, s-u-b-c-o-n-t-r-a-c-t-o-r r-o-s-t-e-r-s, and p-r-i-c-i-n-g a-s-s-u-m-p-t-i-o-n d-r-a-f-t-s

debrief closed — pattern logged for future detection.
